purpose: Golden-path example showing how a topic flows through all 6 agents to produce final product briefs. Use as regression baseline.

story_spine.core_thesis: The Italian table is not a meal — it is a ritual of place, ingredient, and time.
story_spine.narrative_direction: From farm to fork to table: how pasta embodies regional identity, seasonal rhythm, and human connection.

priority_lenses.why: Regional pasta traditions map to geography
Pasta shapes, kitchen tools, market crates

product_family_matrix.why_fit: Pasta shapes + table rituals = meditative subject

validation_report.market_signal: Strong evergreen with seasonal variant potential

to_country_research_agent: Focus on Table & Food and regional specificity, not generic Italy
to_theme_cluster_agent: Prioritize ritual and material culture over restaurant-world references

country_profile.high_level_identity: A country where food is inseparable from place, season, and social ritual.

foods_and_table_rituals.name: Cacio e pepe — Lazio regional identity
Tagliatelle al ragù — Bologna egg pasta culture
Arancini — Sicily street food and market culture
Pasta fresca making ritual — rolling, cutting, resting

routes_and_maps.name: Northern wheat belt to pasta production regions

theme_clusters.cluster_thesis: Pasta shapes embody the geography, climate, and history of their region.
visual_logic: close-up details alternating with full scene
assigned_inventory_items: Cacio e pepe — Lazio regional identity
Tagliatelle al ragù — Bologna egg pasta culture
Arancini — Sicily street food and market culture
Pasta fresca making ritual — rolling, cutting, resting

theme_clusters.cluster_thesis: Buying ingredients for pasta is a cultural practice: which market, which season, which vendor.
assigned_inventory_items: Northern wheat belt to pasta production regions

collection_blueprint.collection_thesis: Pasta is geography made edible. Every shape, every sauce, every ritual belongs to a place.
collection_blueprint.customer_promise: Discover the regional stories behind Italian pasta through meditative coloring, mapping, and recipes.
visual_logic: one ritual or shape per spread

naming_logic.sku_title_pattern: Ink & Roads — Italy — Pasta & Place [Product Type]
naming_logic.example: Ink & Roads — Italy — Pasta & Place Coloring Book

recommended_sku_types.why_fit: Core idea is ritual and tradition
Utensils, shapes, market objects highly reusable

bundle_logic: Bundle 1: Coloring Book + Recipe Cards ($7.99, save $0.99)

prompt_notes: Detail-rich pasta shapes, utensils, hands in action
Avoid cute or cartoonish; aim for sophisticated line art
High detail on protagonist subject, minimal background
production_risks: Pasta shape accuracy important for credibility
Hand positions in coloring must be clear and anatomically sensible

product_briefs.title: Ink & Roads — Italy — Pasta & Place Coloring Book
product_briefs.subtitle: The Shapes and Rituals of Italian Pasta
product_briefs.core_promise: Meditative coloring exploring pasta shapes and table rituals across Italian regions.
content_structure: Cover: feature pasta shape with regional markers
Pages 1-3: Cacio e pepe ritual — ingredients, preparation, plating
Pages 10-12: Table setting and utensil rituals
visual_direction: High detail on pasta shapes, minimal backgrounds
Hands in action: cooking, eating, market buying
Warm editorial tone, nostalgic but contemporary

prompt_package.generation_prompt: Editorial illustration of Italian pasta and table ritual. Subject: [cacio e pepe / tagliatelle / arancini / pasta maker hands / wooden fork and ceramic bowl]. Style: sophisticated black & white line art, warm nostalgic editorial tone, high detail on protagonist subject, minimal background. Medium: pen and ink. Aspect ratio: 8.5x11 portrait. No fills, line art only.
prompt_package.negative_prompt: cartoonish, cute, colored, watercolor, modern, minimalist, 3D, photograph, low detail, clipart
layout_notes: Center hero subject at two-thirds height
thumbnail_notes: Feature one iconic pasta shape on white background

listing_logic.positioning_angle: Narrative coloring — not random drawings, but the real story of Italian pasta culture

risks: Pasta shape accuracy critical — wrong shapes lose credibility with Italian food enthusiasts
Hand anatomy must be correct in cooking ritual pages

quality_gate_notes: All 5 checks passed: prompt testable, visual grammar preserved, 5+ keywords, bundle_role assigned, risks specific

product_briefs.title: Ink & Roads — Italy — Pasta & Place Recipe Cards
product_briefs.subtitle: 5 Regional Pasta Recipes with Story
product_briefs.core_promise: 5 regional pasta recipes with story, ingredients, and ritual context.
content_structure: Card 5: Pasta fresca — the rolling ritual (regional)

prompt_package.generation_prompt: Editorial line art illustration for recipe card. Subject: [pasta dish name + key ingredient or ritual object]. Style: black & white pen and ink, warm nostalgic, high detail on food subject. Aspect ratio: 4x6. No fills.
prompt_package.negative_prompt: cartoon, color, photo, generic food illustration
layout_notes: Illustration top half, recipe text area bottom half
thumbnail_notes: Show one card face with strongest visual subject

product_briefs.pricing_notes: $2.99 USD (support product, pairs with coloring book)
risks: Recipe accuracy must be verified — incorrect proportions damage credibility

product_briefs.title: Ink & Roads — Italy — Pasta & Place Clipart Bundle
product_briefs.subtitle: 45 Pasta, Kitchen & Market Illustrations
product_briefs.core_promise: 45 vector illustrations: pasta shapes, utensils, ingredients, market objects.

deliverables: PNG + SVG ZIP organized by category

prompt_package.generation_prompt: Editorial black & white line art clipart. Subject: [pasta shape / kitchen utensil / market crate / ingredient]. Style: pen and ink, isolated on white, no background, high detail, consistent line weight. No fills.
prompt_package.negative_prompt: colored, gradient, 3D, photo, background, drop shadow
layout_notes: Single object per asset, centered on transparent/white
thumbnail_notes: Grid of 6-9 best assets on clean white background

product_briefs.pricing_notes: $7.99 USD (entry product, reusable across multiple platforms)
risks: 45 assets is a large batch — plan generation in themed sessions of 10-12 to maintain style consistency

launch_sequence: 1. Adult coloring book — hero product, drives traffic
2. Clipart bundle — entry product, 48h after coloring launch
3. Recipe cards — support product, 1 week after
bundle_strategy: Bundle A: Coloring Book + Recipe Cards ($7.99, save $0.99)
Bundle B: All three products ($14.99, save $2.98)
cross_sell_paths: From coloring book → clipart bundle (same visual system, different use)
From recipe cards → illustrated map of regional pasta routes (future product)

lessons_learned: Topic to Story Spine to Lenses to Clusters to Collections to Briefs is a natural flow.
Each agent adds specificity; no step is redundant.
Revision at Pattern-Validation stage saved time by catching generic positioning early.
Inventory assignment to clusters was critical: every item found a home.
